name: SCP-069-J: The Sisters of Cheyenne Point
source: "The sisters of Cheyenne Point" (by Superstar Catalyst Project) is a school adventure dating simulation game based on "SCP-069-J - Sisters of Cheyenne Point" by "Aelanna". You play as a male student who have just moved to a new school called Cheyenne Point Academy.
translation: 由Superstar Catalyst Project开发的《夏安点的姐妹们》，是一款改编自Aelanna创作的《SCP-069-J——夏安点的姐妹们》的校园恋爱模拟冒险游戏。你将扮演一名刚刚转学来到新学校“夏安点学园”的男生。
